# mergeah_usage_by_tool (Data Source)

Read Merge Agent Handler usage_by_tool. Results are available as JSON via response_json; paginated collections are fetched completely.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
data "mergeah_usage_by_tool" "example" {
  start_time = "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
  end_time   = "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z"
}

locals {
  usage_by_tool = jsondecode(data.mergeah_usage_by_tool.example.response_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_time` (String) End of the usage window, ISO 8601 with timezone (for example `2026-04-30T00:00:00Z`). Must be in the past.
- `start_time` (String) Start of the usage window, ISO 8601 with timezone (for example `2026-04-01T00:00:00Z`). Cannot be more than 90 days in the past, and the window cannot exceed 31 days.

### Optional

- `query` (Map of String) Additional documented API query parameters. All pages are fetched automatically. Values must be strings.

### Read-Only

- `response_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object for a detail endpoint, or JSON array containing every item for a collection. Use jsondecode to read fields. Sensitive because API records may contain personal data.
